Summary: Search returns irrelevant results for exact product name
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Go to homepage. 2. Enter exact product name 'HP LP3065' in search box. 3. Press Enter.
Expected Result: Search should return the product 'HP LP3065' as top result or exact match.
Actual Result: Search returns unrelated items and product is not listed in results.

Summary: Add to Cart fails with no error message when quantity > available stock
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open product page for 'MacBook'. 2. Set quantity to 1000. 3. Click 'Add to Cart'.
Expected Result: App should show validation message about insufficient stock or adjust quantity.
Actual Result: Button appears to do nothing; no message shown; cart unchanged.

Summary: Price mismatch on product list vs product detail page
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open category 'Laptops'. 2. Note price on listing for 'Sony VAIO'. 3. Click product and compare price on detail page.
Expected Result: Price should be identical across listing and product detail.
Actual Result: Listing shows $1000 but detail page shows $1200.
Notes: Possible caching or currency conversion bug.

Summary: Checkout page allows proceeding without required shipping address fields
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Add product to cart. 2. Proceed to checkout. 3. Leave 'City' field blank and click 'Continue'.
Expected Result: Form validation should block continuation and show required field error.
Actual Result: User proceeds to payment step; order may succeed with incomplete address.

Summary: Login shows generic error 'An error occurred' on incorrect password instead of helpful message
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Go to Login. 2. Enter valid email and wrong password. 3. Click 'Login'.
Notes: Also check HTTP error codes returned by backend.

Summary: Responsive layout: product grid items overlap at 375px width
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Resize browser to 375px width (mobile). 2. Open category with product grid.
Expected Result: Grid items stack or reflow without overlap.
Actual Result: Product cards overlap and texts become unreadable.

Summary: Broken image icon for some products (image 404)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Browse category 'Cameras'. 2. Observe images for product index 3 and 4.
Actual Result: Placeholder broken-image icon shows; console 404 for asset.
Notes: Likely missing asset path or CDN issue.

Summary: Sorting by Price (Low > High) returns incorrect order
Expected Result: Products displayed from lowest to highest price.
Actual Result: Order appears random; some higher priced items shown first.

Summary: Currency selector doesn't persist choice across pages
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Change currency to 'Euro' on homepage. 2. Navigate to product detail.
Actual Result: Currency resets to USD on new page loads.

Summary: Wishlist icon clickable area misaligned (clicking to right does nothing)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Hover product card. 2. Click heart icon slightly to the right of centre.
Actual Result: No action; only small exact area responds.

Summary: Password reset link emails not sent (or delayed more than 24 hours)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Use 'Forgot Password' flow with valid account. 2. Check email inbox for reset link.
Expected Result: Password reset email arrives within a few minutes.
Notes: Check SMTP server logs and email queue.

Summary: Coupon code field accepts invalid characters and throws server error
Expected Result: Validation should reject invalid characters with client message.
Actual Result: Server throws 500 error; page shows generic error.

Summary: Accessibility: Images missing alt text (fails automated a11y scan)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Run Lighthouse accessibility audit. 2. Inspect image elements.
Expected Result: All meaningful images should have descriptive alt attributes.
Actual Result: Multiple product images have empty or missing alt attributes.

Summary: Profile page shows stale order history (last order missing)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Place an order. 2. Visit Profile > Orders. 3. Refresh page.
Expected Result: New order appears in order history immediately.
Actual Result: Recent order not listed until next day.

Summary: Pagination 'Next' button disabled on last page but still clickable
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Go to category with multiple pages. 2. Navigate to last page. 3. Click 'Next'.
Expected Result: 'Next' should be disabled and not clickable, or hidden.
Actual Result: Button looks disabled but clicking triggers page reload and shows same page.

Summary: SSL mixed content warning on checkout due to HTTP image
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Proceed to checkout over HTTPS. 2. Open console.
Actual Result: Warning: Mixed content - image loaded over HTTP causing lock icon to be broken.

Summary: Product compare feature removes selected items when refreshing page
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Select 3 products to compare. 2. Refresh page.
Expected Result: Selected products remain in compare list after refresh.

Summary: Contact form allows submission with invalid email format
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Go to Contact Us. 2. Enter 'user@@example' as email and submit.
Expected Result: Client-side validation prevents submission and shows error.
Actual Result: Form submits and server returns 400; user sees generic 'error'.
